metadata.description: Azure canvas plugins and a skill-only canvas authoring companion; installs follow the current marketplace checkout.

plugins.name: azure-functions-hosted-skills
plugins.description: Build and run Azure Functions Hosted Skills with a canvas and companion skills.

plugins.name: azure-resources-query
plugins.description: Explore Azure resources with read-only queries, a canvas, and a skill.

plugins.name: canvas-authoring
plugins.description: Create canvas apps with guided setup and reusable UI components from the Microsoft Canvas Toolkit. Includes a background extension used only for skill-usage telemetry.

plugins.name: azure-cost-health-check
plugins.description: Review Azure spend, forecasts, native alerts, and AI billing with a read-only canvas and launcher skill.

plugins.name: azure-sre-agent
plugins.description: Azure SRE Agent canvas for diagnosing failing Azure apps, correlating ICM/S360 tickets, and operating Azure SRE Agent resources.

plugins.name: azure-storage
plugins.description: Azure Storage canvas — browse blobs and containers, bulk transfer with live progress, filter with aggregate statistics, mint and open SAS links, preview blobs, and plan account to account copies, all agent-drivable on one live surface.

plugins.name: containers
plugins.description: Copilot canvas extension for local Docker and Podman: sortable container and image lists, live log streaming, CPU and memory charts, a filesystem browser, image layer size breakdown, and Dockerfile provenance.

plugins.name: azure-functions
plugins.description: Azure Functions: create, edit, modernize, review, run, deploy, and monitor function apps, with optional AI help.
